Q6111.reason: The content-neutral littering ordinance serves an important public interest unrelated to suppressing expression and therefore validly applies to the protestor's symbolic conduct.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove an action, so the plaintiff's attorney's attempted removal was improper and requires remand of the entire case.

Q5651.reason: The general 'as is' clause did not negate the seller's specific misrepresentations about the car's model year and identity.
